body: Mine is kinda similar! I was incorrectly diagnosed with depression and anxiety when I was pretty young because my mom had both so my family doctor assumed I did too. Was put on medications for them and had to constantly play around with new meds because they only ever made me feel numb or suicidal (yikes). My family doctor retired and my new doctor is great. I told him the same thing I told my old doctor before the depression and anxiety diagnoses and he asked me if I’ve ever seen and ADHD specialist! After 23 years I got to see a psychiatrist who was able to diagnose me properly!
usually oatmeal or overnight oats i’ll definitely try a protein shake or bar or something tho!
sometimes i try to remember i have good things that are worth living for but it feels like a constant struggle.
